building.name: Keystone Apartments
building.completed_conflict: This building is dated 1910 in the historical record; the assessor's roll gives the parcel a build year of 1911.

historical_record.description: The Keystone Apartments, designed by Oliver, Foulks & Kaiser — a $500,000 building advertised with a roof garden and children's play annex, a billiard room, a bowling alley, a library and a ballroom, and one of the earliest high-end large apartment buildings in the city. A metal and glass marquee marks its entrance.

Evaluated in the city's citywide survey of large apartment buildings as retaining excellent integrity and appearing eligible under both Criterion A/1 and Criterion C/3, for its architectural quality and for being one of the earliest large, high-end apartment buildings in San Francisco.
